title: A Warm Room for Grandma June

slices.alt: Comic, part 1 of 12: Verdict Picks Toon: A Warm Room for Grandma June Caption: The first snow of the year. Jo's grandmother lives alone.
Comic, part 2 of 12: Grandma June: Don't fuss, dear. I have my old heater.
Comic, part 3 of 12: Jo: Grandma... what is that heater plugged into?
Comic, part 4 of 12: Caption: CPSC: never plug a space heater into an extension cord or a power strip. (Sound: TSSK)
Comic, part 5 of 12: Jo: She's getting a new one. Tonight.
Comic, part 6 of 12: Vera: Good call. One check before you buy any heater this winter.

Comic, part 7 of 12: Caption: Find the model number on the label, then look it up in the recall notice. Board, CPSC recall, October 29, 2026: Dreo DR-HSH015 (black, remote) recalled; Units in the US about 338,800; Hazard fire and burn Source: CPSC notice 27-054. The Dreo in our review is a different model; check yours against the notice.
Comic, part 8 of 12: Grandma June: You drove all this way? Jo: You're worth the trip.
Comic, part 9 of 12: Caption: Straight into the wall. Three feet clear of drapes, furniture and bedding (CPSC).
Comic, part 10 of 12: Caption: Set it near 68°F. In Eco mode it stops heating once the room gets there (Dreo).
Comic, part 11 of 12: Grandma June: Warm at last.
Comic, part 12 of 12: Caption: Off when you sleep or leave: CPSC and NFPA both say so. Goodnight, Grandma. Is the Dreo heater right for your room? Our full review is below.
